title: Cost carousel: motion timing, contrast redlines, and QA handoff
creator: Maya Li
description: Synthesize stakeholder feedback from the compact cost card refresh and produce a final prototype and redlines that address motion timing, color contrast, and edge-case states for the new cost carousel used on per-route dashboards. Deliverables: Figma prototype (interactive), redline spec for engineering, QA checklist, and accessibility notes.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype demonstrates enter/exit motion and focused state for carousel items
Color palette and contrast ratios updated to meet AA for text and icons across light/dark themes
Engineering redlines include pixel values, easing curves, and timing tokens; handed off in a single Figma file and linked PR
QA checklist created and validated by QA lead with test cases for animation performance on low-end machines
Stakeholder sign-off (PM, Eng lead, Accessibility) captured in comments
design_updates: 09/04: Initial synthesis of previous reviews — consolidated contrasting rules for positive/negative delta chips; removed redundant drop shadow on compact cards
09/05: Prototype added: 250ms enter, 180ms exit, cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) easing for card transitions; updated microinteraction spec with keyboard-focus animations
09/06: Adjusted token-sparkline baseline to avoid visual collision with card overflow; added explicit clipping and hover states
09/08: Swapped orange delta chip color to a deeper amber to reach 4.5:1 contrast on 14px text per accessibility review
09/09: Finalized reduced-motion variant (instant cross-fade) and documented a platform switch triggered by prefers-reduced-motion
review_comments: PM (Ava Rodriguez): Confirm rollout behavior — should carousel rotate automatically in reports view? Recommendation: default to manual, optional autoplay behind an experiment flag.
Engineering (Samir Khan): Need explicit layout tokens for compact vs. expanded states; prefer 8px step grid to align with existing metrics panel.
Accessibility (Priya Nair): Delta chips still borderline at 4.2:1 on 12px labels; propose increasing font to 13px or changing chip fill — implemented deeper amber to test.
Design (Leah Summers): Motion feels heavy on 250ms for rapid route toggles; suggest 200ms for enter when multiple cards animate simultaneously — adjusted in prototype.
QA (Jordan Blake): Add tests for keyboard-only carousel navigation and for fallback when WebGL/GPUs are throttled on older devices.
decisions: Default carousel will be manual (swipe/click/keyboard); autoplay behind experiment 'cost_carousel_autoplay' to be gated by PM and Data.
Motion timings standardized: enter 200ms, exit 160ms, easing cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); reduced-motion switches to 0ms cross-fade.
Color change to amber (#B36400) for positive/negative deltas to meet AA contrast at 13px; chip font set to 13px for compact cards.
Engineering will implement clipping and explicit token-sparkline layer to avoid z-index anomalies on small widths.

QA to validate checklist across Chrome, Safari, and Firefox on macOS and Windows; include one low-end laptop test (Core i3) — owner: Jordan Blake — due 2025-09-16
Schedule stakeholder review meeting (PM, Eng lead, Accessibility) for 2025-09-17 to capture final sign-off
